messages:
Mia: Heads-up — simulation shows a ~2.3x embed+rerank QPS spike this weekend (Sat 18:00-23:00 UTC). Can ops propose a pool split to avoid p95 blowups? cc @Leah
Ravi: Can you paste the sim numbers? is this user-facing rerank or background jobs?
Mia: Mostly realtime user flows (search + session rerank). Peak requests ~5.6k/min, median seq len 128, rerank candidates 25. Tokens/sec estimate ~1.2M across all pools.
Jun: Current mixed pool is at p95 ~1.8s for rerank at ~70% util. Embedding batch jobs are already scheduled nightly at 02:00 UTC — so they shouldn't overlap, but backfills sometimes run earlier.
Leah: Proposal: split into a dedicated low-latency rerank pool + a spot-backed embed backfill pool. Rough GPU-hr calc: rerank reserve = 8 A10G * 6h * 2 days = 96 GPU-hr, embed backfill = 24 GPUs * 4h = 192 GPU-hr. Estimated weekend cost delta ~$2.5k.
Ravi: How do we handle cold KV cache? cold starts will still spike p95.
Mia: Plan: keep a warm replica per node and run a short pre-warm job 30m before window to populate common prefixes. TTL for warm cache set to 30m during surge period.
ops-bot: notice: pool reservation requires ~24h lead time; creation+kernel profiling ~45m.
Sam: Network FYI — APAC has limited A10G quota this weekend. If traffic shifts we'll failover rerank to us-west which adds ~80ms. Are we OK with that p95 delta?
Leah: We can route only embed backfill to us-west and keep rerank in eu-west/us-central. Simple routing policy change.
Jun: Safety knobs: add fallback to quantized 8-bit rerank variant if p95 > 2s for 3m, and force batch_size=1 for rerank during the window.
Ravi: Any NVLink / PCIe saturation risk during heavy KV syncs?
Jun: Yes — limit concurrent checkpoint syncs to 2 and watch host mem/PCIe counters.
Mia: Action items: create rerank pool (8 reserved A10G), embed pool (16 spot A100 backfill), add pre-warm job, add autofallback to 8-bit variant. I'll update the forecasting sheet with GPU-hrs + cost and open the config PR. Target to merge by Friday 12:00 UTC.
Leah: +1. Ping me when PR is up and I'll review routing policy.
Sam: I'll update the weekend runbook with failover steps and expected latency delta.
ops-bot: monitor created: rerank-p95 > 1.2s (alert), embed-queue-length > 200 (warning).
Mia: Simulation command we used:
```
./simulate_traffic --qps 90 --avg_seq 128 --rerank_cands 25 --duration 6h
```
Mia: Thanks all — leaving notes in the forecast sheet and will attach the raw sim output.
